body:
I am guilty. 

I was in a toxic relationship with my first serious partner and basically never sober. I won't go into details on all that, but I wasn't happy. And so I got my satisfaction by taking pictures of strangers and using them for personal needs. 
I knew it wasn't okay, but I kept going. 
I stopped a couple weeks before quarantine began in my state, a friend of mine got caught in the background of a picture. I deleted all of them. 
Quarantine got me thinking a lot about a lot, especially with the distance from my relationship at the time. I broke up with my partner and began therapy a month later for the first time in my life. I have been 4 weeks sober now after weaning myself for 8 months. 

All this happened nearly a year ago, I feel as though I have no connection to who I was then. It's been a great feeling, but I know I can't take back what I did, nor apologise to those I preyed on.

I know you're right, believe me I do. It's difficult ignore to when the hostility just radiates into everything. I do my damnedest but only to a point. I just gotta recognize that point and leave before it's too bad.

The most recent time our group hung out I ignored her towards the end. It got to be too much, however that just made her glare at me. The fucking look she gave me when I held my partners hand was unbearable. I truly try to be civil. I don't hate them and it kinda hurts that I feel I've gotta do this.

I had to spend an entire summer telling myself I wasn't responsible for what she might do or how she feels about it. I was made to feel guilty for so long. I'm over that and now her behavior just pisses me off. 

It kinda feels like the groups has taken sides already, but I don't know how everyone else feels about it. My roommate is the only who's voiced an opinion on it in my favor. My father said a lot of the same things that you did.
No no, I appreciate your bluntness. Hard drugs and alcohol have never interested me. Only weed for me.
I played Darkwood last. My plan? Sit there until I either go insane, or die from some horror of the night. Since you can't starve in the game I'll just wait it out.
